rationale: The main finite order-key QUBO and its penalty/encoding remain outside this predicate checker. Separately, contract_applicability[0] explicitly states a finite-pivot Grover predicate: exceed every earlier magnitude and be at least every later magnitude. Bind only this conditional local relation, even though practical/reversible applicability remains unresolved. The finite guard is explicit; nonfinite states are sent to a declared classical path in the plan, which is not executed or proved here. A guarded finite pass must not be reported as validation of the QUBO, whole-domain repair or established Grover deployment.

interpretations.meaning: The separately stated Grover comparison relation, on all-finite current pivot magnitudes only.
interpretations.expression: all(values[i] > values[j] for j in indices if j < i) and all(values[i] >= values[k] for k in indices if k > i)
